confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation is less certain because July is hot and rates vary by season and by medina versus Gueliz location. Drink prices are less certain because alcohol availability and pricing vary by venue. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine by glass about 2x beer). The FX observation comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page and was not read directly; the RBA F11 table was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Moroccan tourist-city price levels, reflecting typical medina and Gueliz pricing. No specific external comparable city was used.
